description: This source file defines structures and a class related to managing nodes in a networked application. It includes data models for node information, response handling, and a store class that manages fetching and updating the list of nodes asynchronously.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the list of nodes, handling periodic refreshes, and maintaining state related to node data.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins periodic refresh of node data, starting a detached asynchronous loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic refresh loop and cancels ongoing tasks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest list of nodes from a remote service and updates internal state.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Helper method to determine if an error indicates a cancelled asynchronous operation.
